messages.8 направлений на экране: граница захвата: 8 directions on the screen: the boundary of capture found by bisection on the tracer itself (its outcome for each ray); the curve is the closed form of the spherical photon orbits; the tolerance is derived for each direction: the round-off error of d₃₄ = (r₄ − r₃)²/4, whose sign decides the outcome, divided by its slope, plus the accuracy of the curve's formula and the last step of the bisection

Complex states with m ≠ 0 make a doughnut cloud, and the current flows in rings around the z axis (the arrows). A superposition of two levels (for example 1s + 2p_z) oscillates at the Bohr frequency ω = ΔE/ħ: the phases of the period are revealed when the world's time reaches them; after that the cloud repeats (verified: one period T later it equals the initial one).

messages.Волновая функция эволюционирует с неэрми: The wave function evolves with the non-Hermitian H_eff = H − (i/2)Σ L†L until the squared norm falls to a random r, then jumps ψ → L_mψ/‖L_mψ‖ with probability ∝ ‖L_mψ‖²; the mean of |ψ⟩⟨ψ| over trajectories equals the solution of the Lindblad equation.
messages.Волновые пакеты частиц в сцене из потенц: Wave packets of particles in a scene of potentials, fields and detectors. Every particle is its own wave by the Schrödinger equation (Pauli for spin); the particles do not interact. Everything is added and changed at the current moment; the detectors absorb probability, a position measurement is an action.
messages.Волны медленного источника по формуле Эй: Waves of a slow source by Einstein's formula: the polarisations h₊, h× for a given direction of observation from the computed trajectory (position, velocity, acceleration, jerk), the luminosity and the angular-momentum flux; the energy flux integrated over a sphere from the waves themselves equals the quadrupole luminosity.

messages.Вращение: шероховатый диск на пути пучка: Rotation: a rough disc in the beam's path scatters the light; the detector looks through a ±l mode filter (as in Lavery et al., 2013): the part that kept +l is not shifted, the part scattered into −l is shifted by −2lf, so the intensity beats at the frequency 2|l|f; the light scattered onto the axis is shifted by −lf. A Dove prism (Courtial et al., 1998) turns the image twice as fast as itself and changes the sign of l: in an interferometer the power beats at the frequency 2|l|f. The detector collects samples as the time goes on; every two turns the spectrum of the samples gives the measured frequency, which is compared with the formula. The rotation frequency f can be changed on the fly (on the left). The element on the screen turns in the world's real time while the optical phase is slowed: their mutual turning in the picture is not the shift that is measured.
messages.Времена первого прихода частиц Бома прот: First arrival times of the Bohm particles against the law (Kolmogorov–Smirnov)
messages.Времениподобная геодезическая в экватори: A timelike geodesic in the equatorial plane, piece by piece: Binet's equation for u = M/r scaled by the initial radius, together with t and τ; radial orbits in proper time; periapsides, apoapsides, turns, the horizon, the surface and escape as events on the dense output of DOP853; the drift of e from the state; a second independent scheme (the geodesic equations in τ) to check e, l and the normalisation; the proper time of a fall by the quadrature τ = ∫dr/√R(r).
messages.Временные профили (гауссов импульс, моду: Time profiles (a Gaussian pulse, a modulated Gaussian, a continuous wave with a smooth switch-on, samples); current sources J and M at a point, on a line or plane and in a volume (soft and hard: a hard E is set after the E update, a hard H after the H update); a plane wave by the total-field/scattered-field method, built as an exact plane wave of the Yee grid (every frequency with the wave vector from the grid's dispersion relation), so that the leak through the boundary is the round-off level plus what the start of the run cuts off (the tail of the series' window).

messages.Время, за которое ящик доходит до нового: The time in which the box reaches its new size (affinely): the size changes uniformly, by a small affine step at every computing step, the work of each step counted. The longer (the slower the box's faces compared with the speed of sound, ≈ 320 m/s in argon gas at 300 K), the closer to the quasi-static adiabat: argon gas (300 atoms, 300 K) compressed 12 → 11 nm and returned heats by ≈ 16 K at once, by ≈ 0.7 K over 10 ps, by ≈ 0.6 K over 50 ps, by 0 ± 0.2 K over 200 ps (measured, 4 runs). 0: at once (irreversible). While the size changes, the current size is in the frame; the end of the change is an event with the work

messages.Источник в центре выпускает пары по одно: The source in the middle emits pairs one at a time (a Poisson stream); the particles fly to the stations of Alice (−L) and Bob (+L). Each station has two settings of its analyser; in the mode of random choice, a bit of the station's generator chooses the setting τ before the particle arrives. The outcome (+ or −) of each particle is computed and shown at the moment it arrives: by the Born rule for the entangled state, or by a model of local hidden variables. The statistics are the coincidence counts of this run; the expectations of the law and the bounds 2 and 2√2 are in “Checks”. The LHV curve on the plot E(Δ) in a quantum world is for comparison only (lfphys.theories.alternatives.local_hidden).
messages.Источник выпускает фотоны по одному (пуа: The source emits photons one by one (a Poisson stream) onto a planar structure: a boundary between two media, an anti-reflection layer, a Bragg mirror, a Fabry–Pérot film, a metal film or a prism's face (total internal reflection; with a gap, tunnelling). For every set-up the run computes, with the transfer matrices of the engine lfphys, the amplitudes r, t and the probabilities R, T, A, the curves R(θ), T(θ), R(λ), T(λ) and the field |E|² inside the structure. Every photon that reaches the structure gets its fate by the Born rule with these probabilities; we learn it when the photon reaches a detector (an absorbed one vanishes in the structure). The counters are the accumulation of these events, next to the run's expectation.
messages.Источник выпускает частицы по одной (пуа: The source emits particles one at a time (a Poisson stream). Each particle is its own wave behind the slits (its own wavelength, source point, internal state, recoil from a scattered photon); at the slits the elements and the observer act on it, in front of the screen the analyser; its place on the screen follows the Born rule with its marks; the pattern is the accumulation of these events. Left: the view from above, the expected wave (the run's ensemble), the particles in flight, the flow lines. Right: the screen and the histogram with the run's expectation. A change of the set-up starts a new segment; particles that passed the slits before the change and arrived after it are marked as transitional.

messages.Каждая частица спонтанно локализуется с: Every particle localises spontaneously at a rate λ per u by a Gaussian of width r_C; for the density matrix, a random kick q ~ N(0, 1/(2r_C²)).
messages.Каждая частица — свой волновой пакет по: Every particle is its own wave packet under the Schrödinger or the Pauli equation (the particles do not interact); a common potential of shapes with smooth edges (the edge width is a physical length), magnetic fields (the Landau gauge for a uniform field in a region, an Aharonov–Bohm tube, spin through the magnetic moment), absorbing detectors with the absorbed probability accounted for (norm + absorbed = 1), unsharp position measurement (Gaussian Kraus operators), localization by an environment (the Lindblad equation) by quantum jumps, a which-path mark; checks: the energy of a closed system, the flux through a plane, the time-step error.
messages.Каждое поперечное случайное воздействие: Each random transverse kick (a point of the source, the recoil of a scattered photon, a GRW hit) shifts the paraxial pattern as a whole; the ensemble's pattern is a convolution with the distribution of the shift, through characteristic functions in closed form; the spectrum: Gauss–Hermite nodes.
messages.Каждую часть можно выключить, чтобы виде: Each part can be switched off to see the others. The slice windows stay.
messages.Каждый парциальный коэффициент Ми разлож: Each partial Mie coefficient is split into the wave reflected by the sphere's surface (p = 0, together with diffraction), the wave transmitted straight through (p = 1) and those transmitted after p − 1 internal reflections (p = 2: the primary rainbow, p = 3: the secondary); the sum of the series (in closed form) equals the Mie coefficients.
messages.Каждый пиксель экрана далёкого наблюдате: Every pixel of a distant observer's screen is a photon traced back in closed form: captured by the hole (the shadow) or come from far away, and where it crossed the plane of the disk, the n-th crossing along the ray traced back: at a moderate inclination n = 0 is the direct image, n = 1 the lensing ring, n = 2 the photon ring; nearly edge-on the lower face of the disk is seen directly as n = 1. The brightness is the sum of g⁴J(r) over the crossings (a source model). When the image is complete, the tracer's edge of the shadow is verified against Bardeen's formula, the rings against their exponential demagnification, the size against EHT.

messages.Картина на экране — вероятность, втекающ: The pattern on the screen is the probability flowing into the screen, accumulated as the wave arrives. The Bohm particles start from points distributed by |ψ|² and follow the probability current of the same wave; a trajectory's colour is the slit the particle went through. In a symmetric set-up the trajectories do not cross the axis; with a path mark they do.
messages.Картина — |ψ|², сумма по частицам (кажда: The picture is |ψ|², the sum over the particles (each its own probability). The detectors absorb probability: how much each absorbed is in “Probes” and in the particle's “now”. “Measure the position” (an action) collapses the wave to the outcome by the Born rule; a cross marks the outcome.
messages.Картина — выбранное поле (модуль скорост: The picture is the chosen field (speed, vorticity, pressure, dye); the arrows are the velocity. The forces on the bodies (drag and lift, their coefficients) are in the body's “now” and in “Checks”: over the last step (they carry the scheme's standing sound wave) and averaged over the domain's sound period (the window is given); there too are the balances of mass, momentum and dye and the Mach and cell Reynolds numbers (stability limits, not accuracy ones).
messages.Квантовая механика не даёт одного правил: Quantum mechanics gives no single rule for the arrival time (there is no time operator). The world computes several: the quantum flux; the first arrivals of the Bohm particles (their ensemble follows the trajectories of the same wave); Aharonov–Bohm–Kijowski and the semiclassical rule (from the momenta of the initial state, free flight only); the absorbing boundary ∂ψ/∂z = iκψ (Werner, Tumulka); the exponential rules of Wlodarz and of Marchewka–Schuss, where the rate of clicks is proportional to |ψ|² or |∂ψ|² on the plane; the soft detector, a second run of the same experiment with an absorbing potential −iW₀ behind the plane (it reflects a part of the wave).
messages.Квантовая механика не задаёт время прихо: Quantum mechanics does not fix the arrival time uniquely; the world shows where the rules agree (far from the source) and where they diverge: near the source, for a train of packets, under backflow, behind two slits.
messages.Квантовая механика — общепринятая физика: Quantum mechanics is the accepted physics. Local hidden variables are a “what if” modification: the outcome of each side is set by its setting and by a common parameter from the source.

messages.Классическая МД в 2-D и 3-D: сорта части: Classical MD in 2-D and 3-D: particle species (mass, charge, σ, ε), molecules with bonds and angles, a short-range pair potential (from theories.models) by Verlet lists, the Coulomb interaction (a direct sum in a box with walls), walls (specular, thermal with diffuse re-emission — a heat bath, soft), a movable piston (mass, external pressure, work), a uniform field; velocity Verlet (NVE), the CSVR (Bussi–Donadio–Parrinello) and Langevin (BAOAB) thermostats, also in a region of space; changes at the current moment (transactional): among them the pair model, the time step, an axis periodic or with walls, many molecules in one edit, the box size (an affine deformation at once or over a given time in small steps, the work on the system accounted for exactly, to first order in the affine stress; or a wall shift); temperature, pressure from the virial and from the momentum given to the walls, energies, momentum, g(r), MSD, the velocity distribution, heat and work counters, the step error from a companion run with dt/2; the state is plain data, continued bit for bit.
messages.Когда частица придёт к детектору? Пакет: When does the particle arrive at the detector? A packet flies to a plane freely or through two slits; the run solves the Schrödinger equation and, from the record on the plane and the initial state, computes the distribution of the arrival time by the quantum flux, the Bohm trajectories, Aharonov–Bohm–Kijowski, the semiclassical rule, the absorbing boundary, the rules of Wlodarz and of Marchewka–Schuss, and the soft detector.
messages.Компонента с w(a) = w0 + wa(1 − a) и пло: A component with w(a) = w0 + wa(1 − a) and the density ρ(a)/ρ(1) = a^(−3(1+w0+wa)) exp(−3wa(1 − a)) from the continuity equation of GR; it plugs into the core's FLRW background (core.cosmology.flrw) in place of Λ; wa = 0 is a constant w, (w0, wa) = (−1, 0) the cosmological constant.

When the craft is back at rest, the gyroscopes turn out to be turned: this is the holonomy of the loop its velocity ran in velocity space (Thomas precession; for two boosts, the Wigner rotation).

A craft starts at rest and flies a manoeuvre: burns and turns of its thrust in its own frame. Its gyroscopes are carried without rotation (Fermi–Walker); back at rest, they turn out to be turned: this is the holonomy of the loop its velocity ran in velocity space. The rotation is computed exactly (SO(3) and the spinor in SU(2)), checked against the loop's area (Gauss–Bonnet) for planar loops and compared with the isoperimetric bound at the same fuel.

messages.Меняется в текущий момент (см. «Как меня: Changed at the current moment (see “How to change the box size” and “Time of the size change”). Affinely: the atoms' coordinates along the axis are multiplied by L′/L, their velocities relative to the centre of mass by L/L′ (for the motion relative to the centre of mass a canonical transformation, the volume step of Andersen's barostat). The work done on the system is the change of its energy, counted in the first law. Over a given time (a step at every computing step) the compression is the closer to quasi-static the slower it is: the work tends to −∫P dV along the adiabat, compression and return hardly heat; at once (time 0) it is irreversible: the matter is out of equilibrium after the jump and heats up (argon gas, 300 atoms at 300 K, 12 → 11 → 12 nm: at once ≈ 16 K, over 10 ps ≈ 0.7 K, over 50 ps ≈ 0.6 K, over 200 ps 0 ± 0.2 K; see the README). Refused with the reason when atoms would overlap (a jump), a molecule's bond would change its length by more than 10 % (a jump), the cutoff radius would exceed half the box, the axis is the piston's (move the piston), or the time step does not resolve the collisions (compression heats)

messages.Меняется на ходу: пластина перестраивает: Changes on the fly: the plate is rebuilt at the current moment, the experiment's window, the screen and the packet stay; the part of the wave already where the wall changed feels the change at once (the event gives this number). The slits must stay inside the screen, the plate between the source and the screen.
messages.Металл: n (действительная часть показате: Metal: n (the real part of the index)
messages.Метка в щели B: поворот θ, °: Mark in slit B: turn θ, °
messages.Метка пути: поле, поворачивающее спин в: Path mark: a field turning the spin in slit B
messages.Метки пути: внутренние состояния, элемен: Which-path marks: internal states, elements, a qubit detector, the Born rule
messages.Метрика Керра–Ньюмена (масса, спин a, за: The Kerr–Newman metric (mass, spin a, charge q) in Boyer–Lindquist coordinates: horizons, ergosurface, circular equatorial orbits (Ω, E, L, clock rate), photon orbits and the ISCO; the tetrad of the zero-angular-momentum observer (ZAMO): initial conditions from the velocity or the ray direction it measures; Hamilton's geodesic equations (Carter's separated form) for many bodies and photons at once, stepped in the distant observer's time t, with the proper time of every body; conserved E, L, Carter constant K and the mass shell; events: capture by the horizon (with the proper time of the crossing) and escape beyond a given radius; the observer's camera (a ZAMO or a moving one): for every pixel the ray is traced back to the shadow or to a direction on the celestial sphere, with the ray's Bardeen constants and the frequency shift.
messages.Метрика Керра–Ньюмена (спин a, заряд дыр: The Kerr–Newman metric (spin a, hole charge q; q = 0 is Kerr) in Boyer–Lindquist coordinates, E, L_z and the Carter constant Q from the state (x, p), Hamilton's equations of motion in Mino time for any geodesics of neutral bodies and of light (null and timelike), DOP853 integration: an independent second route for the closed-form solutions.
messages.Микроскоп: рассеяние одного фотона в пло: Microscope: one photon scattered in the plane of the slits, a dipole pattern (Thomson or Rayleigh), the longitudinal recoil neglected; “direction recorded” means the photon in the lens's back focal plane (a direction, not an image of the slits).
messages.Мир «что если»: метрика Йоханнсена (при: A “what if” world: the Johannsen metric (α = 0 is Kerr). The engine computes the edge of its shadow from its photon orbits, its circular orbits and ergosphere, and δ against the EHT bounds; the image of the disk is not computed in it.
messages.Мир в объёме: главный вид — 3D-сцена, ря: A world in a volume: the main view is the 3D scene, beside it the slice z = 0.
messages.Мир восстанавливается: действия — когда: The world is being restored: actions when the record goes on
messages.Мир восстанавливается: новый мир — когда: The world is being restored: a new world when the record goes on
messages.Мир восстанавливается: срезы и сцену — к: The world is being restored: slices and the scene when the record goes on.
messages.Мир восстанавливается: установку можно м: The world is being restored: the set-up can be changed when the record goes on

The world is paused; ⏺ resumes it.

messages.Модель (подогнанные параметры): верны ра: A model (fitted parameters): the splittings of the levels are right, not the absolute masses.

messages.Момент встречи фронта вспышки с приёмник: The moment the front of a flash meets the receiver: in flat space-time, a quadratic equation on each inertial piece (SR: the front is centred on the point of the flash whatever the motion of the source); in GR, the exact connection by geodesics and a root search for a moving receiver.
messages.Момент по Пойнтингу ∫(r × P)_z на фотон: Poynting angular momentum ∫(r × P)_z per photon per unit length
messages.Момент события на Андромеде (лаб.), сут: Event on Andromeda at the moment (lab), days
messages.Мощность через плоскости z: одна и та же: Power through the planes z: one and the same
messages.Мощность через плоскости z: тождество су: Power through the planes z: an identity of the sum (a check of the code)

messages.Мягкий детектор: высота W₀, в E₀: Soft detector: height W₀, in E₀
messages.Мягкий детектор: отражённая доля против: Soft detector: the reflected fraction against the stationary theory
messages.На кадр вперёд; в конце записи — посчита: A frame forward; at the end of the record, compute one step
messages.На спин — через магнитный момент; на зар: On the spin through the magnetic moment; on a charge through the vector potential (only Bz in a plane, a field along an axis in a volume)
messages.На ходу меняются и детекторы: сила λ₀ эк: The detectors change on the fly too: the strength λ₀ of the exponential rules and the height W₀ of the soft detector. Before the change a rule is computed with the old value, after it with the new one; if the signal has not arrived by then, the experiment is as with the new value from the very start. The absorbing boundary κ is a world parameter: its rule is computed from the initial state for one κ for the whole experiment.
messages.Наблюдатель далеко, под углом θ к оси вр: The observer is far away, at an angle θ to the spin axis. Every pixel of the observer's screen is a photon traced back in closed form (elliptic functions, Gralla & Lupsasca 2020): either it came out of the hole (this does not happen, so that direction is dark: the shadow), or it came from far away, crossing on its way the equator, where a thin disk of gas shines. The brightness of a pixel is the sum of g⁴J(r) over the crossings: g is the redshift of the gas (rotation and gravity), J(r) the emission of the disk (a source model).
messages.Наблюдатель на расстоянии R под наклоном: An observer at the distance R at the inclination ι: h₊, h× by the quadrupole formula
messages.Наблюдатель не выключает интерференцию п: The observer does not switch interference off by a rule: each particle carries marks away from the slits (polarisation, spin, the detector's state, the photon's recoil), and the pattern is computed by the Born rule with their overlap.
messages.Наблюдатель: детектор пути у щели B: Observer: a path detector at slit B
messages.Наблюдатель: скорость и поле зрения (в л: Observer: velocity and field of view (in the lab)

messages.Над барьером: отражение без препятствия: Above the barrier: reflection with nothing in the way
messages.Наибольшее отклонение от массовой оболоч: Largest deviation from the mass shell p·p = −μ²
messages.Наибольший уход постоянной Картера K у т: Largest drift of Carter's constant K of the bodies (fraction of K)
messages.Наклон наблюдателя к оси вращения θ, °: Observer's inclination to the spin axis θ, °
messages.Наклон орбиты к лучу зрения ι, °: Inclination of the orbit to the line of sight ι, °
messages.Наклонять выбранный срез (два кольца; E): Tilt the selected slice (two rings; E)
messages.Накопленный угол поворота (по ходу расчё: Accumulated angle of rotation (along the computation), rad: against the area

messages.Насколько слабеет связь на малых расстоя: How the coupling weakens at short distances, and how a model of quark confinement relates to the core of QCD.
messages.Настоящий двухщелевой опыт: где ломается: A real double-slit experiment: where the paraxial theory breaks down (narrow slits, large angles), how a path mark erases the interference, and how the Bohm trajectories run.
messages.Начальное состояние: распределение импул: Initial state: the momentum distribution along the flight against the exact one
messages.Начать в этом запуске новый мир из сцены: Start a new world in this run from the file's scene? The current world stays in the record.

messages.Небо вокруг антисолнечной точки: посчита: The sky around the antisolar point: the computed colour (the Sun behind you)
messages.Небо: оценка ошибки суммы по размерам (н: Sky: the error estimate of the sum over the sizes (the largest over the wavelengths)

messages.Неплоская петля: граница доказана только: A non-planar loop: the bound is proven only for planar loops; here it is a line of comparison.
messages.Неполяризованный источник — смесь 50/50: An unpolarised source is a 50/50 mixture of s and p photons: an isotropic planar structure does not mix them, so this is the same as the density matrix ρ = I/2.
messages.Нерезкое измерение положения с разрешени: An unsharp measurement of the position with resolution σ (Gaussian Kraus operators): the outcome is a point by the Born rule or “already absorbed by a detector”; the wave collapses to the outcome
messages.Несжимаемая жидкость в 2-D: решёточный м: Incompressible fluid in 2-D: the lattice Boltzmann method (D2Q9)
messages.Нижний уровень ловушки (спектральный мет: Lowest level of the trap (spectral method)

messages.Нормаль плоскости петли: наклон от оси z: Normal of the loop's plane: tilt from the z axis θ, °
messages.Нулевые геодезические Керра: постоянная: Kerr null geodesics: Carter constant, Mino time, critical curve
messages.Ньютоново притяжение света имеет смысл т: Newtonian attraction of light makes sense only for corpuscles, that is, for emission kinematics.
messages.Ньютоново тяготение медленных тел: орбит: Newtonian gravity of slow bodies: Kepler orbits
messages.Ньютоновская механика: скорость меньше с: Newtonian mechanics: the speed is below the speed of light (and far below it, for accuracy)
messages.Ньютоновская чёрная дыра 1000 M☉ и звёзд: A Newtonian black hole of 1000 M☉ and stars: orbits and capture
messages.Ньютоновы корпускулы у чёрной дыры (моди: Newtonian corpuscles at a black hole (modification)
messages.ОТО несовместима с эфиром (метрика Шварц: GR is incompatible with the ether (the Schwarzschild metric is locally Lorentzian), so gravity is “No gravity”: the body neither deflects nor delays light, it only absorbs it; the motion of the bodies (the Earth's orbit) stays as prescribed.
messages.ОТО требует СТО: метрика Шварцшильда лок: GR requires SR: the Schwarzschild metric is locally Lorentzian. For the ether or emission theory choose “No gravity” or “Newton” (emission theory only).
messages.ОТО — общепринятая теория (для сценариев: GR is the accepted theory (for the scenarios with a mass). “No gravity” in a scenario with a mass is a modification.
messages.ОТО — общепринятая теория. Ньютоново тяг: GR is the accepted theory. Newtonian gravity is the approximation of a weak field and low speeds; a world with it is flagged as modified physics.
messages.ОТО: тела и свет у чёрной дыры Керра–Нью: GR: bodies and light near a Kerr–Newman black hole
messages.ОТО: у чёрной дыры Керра–Ньюмена: GR: near a Kerr–Newman black hole
messages.Облако |ψ|² — плотность вероятности для: The cloud |ψ|² is the probability density of the vector r between the quark and the antiquark (the centre of mass at the origin) in the Cornell model V(r) = −κ/r + r/a² (a fitted model: it predicts the splittings of the levels, not the absolute masses). The radial functions are a numerical solution whose accuracy is measured; the arrows are the probability current; the slices are planes at any angle with |ψ|² and the phase.
messages.Облако |ψ|² — плотность вероятности найт: The cloud |ψ|² is the probability density of finding the electron at a point relative to the nucleus (the exact solution of the Schrödinger equation with the reduced mass). The arrows are the probability current. The slices are planes at any angle: |ψ|² and the phase of ψ, computed for the plane and verified against an independent calculation.
messages.Облако через период Бора T совпадает с о: The cloud one Bohr period T later equals the cloud at t = 0
messages.Облако — плотность вероятности |ψ|² для: The cloud is the probability density |ψ|² of the vector r between the quark and the antiquark (the centre of mass at the origin). The radial functions are a numerical solution of the radial equation (a sine basis, Richardson extrapolation); its accuracy is checked by a second solution on a finer grid (“Convergence”: the difference is below half a step of the 8-bit picture).
messages.Область расширилась — F: показать содерж: The region grew — F: show the content, Shift+F: the whole region
messages.Обратный ток: поток через плоскость мест: Backflow: the flux through the plane is negative in places, Bohm's first arrivals are not
messages.Обтекание цилиндра, Re = 20 (постановка: Flow past a cylinder, Re = 20 (the DFG 2D-1 set-up: mean C_x, C_y against the ranges of Schäfer & Turek)
messages.Общие орбиты Керра: эксцентричные и накл: General Kerr orbits: eccentric and inclined (Mino time)
messages.Объект движется как целое с этой скорост: The object moves as a whole with this velocity (a throw with the mouse sets it); the atoms' thermal motion follows the temperature
messages.Объекты сцены с параметрами и их текущим: The scene's objects with their parameters and current state, the world's laws and the time — into a file
messages.Объекты текущей сцены переходят в новый: The objects of the current scene go into the new world. Their state (positions, velocities, a field) goes with them where the section can carry it; the message after the carry-over says what went with its state, what started afresh from its parameters, what was changed and what the new world refused
messages.Объекты, с которых начинается мир (сцена: The objects the world starts with (a scenario or a loaded scene file)
messages.Объявленное правило (не закон): в момент: A declared rule (not a law): at the moment (a, Q) changes, every body keeps its Boyer–Lindquist coordinates (r, θ, φ), its proper time and the momentum measured by the local zero-angular-momentum observer (ZAMO; the energy from the mass shell), i.e. its velocity as well, without capping it below c; a photon keeps the direction and the frequency measured by the ZAMO; E, L, p_r, p_θ and the Carter constant are new; the drift accounting starts anew. Refused: a² + Q² ≥ 1, an active body inside the new capture radius; observer positions the new metric does not allow.
messages.Объём — интенсивность |E|² пучка (кольцо: The volume is the intensity |E|² of the beam (a ring: on the vortex's axis the field is zero). The yellow lines are the energy flow (the Poynting vector), the blue ones the orbital (canonical) current: they twist around the axis like spirals. The slices show the intensity and the phase on a colour wheel (the mode “phase”): a turn around the axis gives l full turns of the colour.
messages.Обычное пространство: траектория и гирос: Ordinary space: the trajectory and the gyroscopes in Thomas precession
messages.Огрубить сетку с краями по ней: Coarsen the grid with edges to match
messages.Один пакет: все правила почти совпадают: One packet: far from the source all the rules almost agree
messages.Один слой: r и t запуска = сумма многокр: One layer: the run's r and t = the sum of multiple reflections (Airy, complex Fresnel coefficients)
messages.Один фотон сейчас, сверх пуассоновского: One photon now, on top of the Poisson stream
messages.Одна длина волны: цвет — её спектральный: One wavelength: the colour is its spectral colour.
messages.Одна щель (B закрыта): огибающая без пол: One slit (B closed): the envelope without fringes
messages.Однородная изотропная вселенная (ФЛРУ):: Homogeneous isotropic universe (FLRW): H(z), distances, ages, a(t)
messages.Однородная объёмная сила (схема Гуо). В: A uniform body force (Guo's scheme). In a fluid of constant density it changes only the pressure (hydrostatic, at once) while the walls and the outlets balance it; along a periodic axis it drives the flow like a pressure drop. The scheme carries its hydrostatic density spread g·L/c_s² (c_s is the scheme's speed of sound, not the fluid's): by default the largest force the scheme of this world carries (up to 9.81 m/s²); for a larger one, a larger “largest expected velocity” (a new world)
messages.Однородное поле вниз по y; не у твёрдых: A uniform field down along y; not for hard spheres
messages.Ожидаемая картина ансамбля в параксиальн: The expected pattern of an ensemble in the paraxial approximation (without Monte Carlo)
messages.Ожидание закона: |S| ≤ 2√2 (граница Цире: Expectation of the law: |S| ≤ 2√2 (the Tsirelson bound)
messages.Ожидание модели ЛСП и граница Цирельсона: Expectation of the LHV model and the Tsirelson bound 2√2 (for information)
messages.Ожидание модели ЛСП: |S| ≤ 2 (граница CH: Expectation of the LHV model: |S| ≤ 2 (the CHSH bound)
messages.Окно каждого среза — справа от 3D, в цве: The window of each slice is to the right of the 3-D view, in the colour of its plane; pointing at a window highlights its plane. A window shows the intensity, the amplitude, its logarithm or the phase; the axes are in µm; under the cursor, the coordinates and the value; CSV gives the slice's data. The hatched zone next to the aperture is where the field is band-limited by the grid.
messages.Окно расчёта: периодические копии на глу: Computation window: periodic copies at the depth z_max
messages.Окно справа от сцены — плоскость опыта:: The window to the right of the scene is the plane of the experiment: the intensity, the amplitude, its logarithm or the phase, with the trajectories over it. At the bottom right is the screen: the computed pattern, the particles' hits and, at the end, the approximate theories for comparison.
messages.Окно — квадрат (куб) с центром в нуле. М: The window is a square (a cube) centred at zero. Changes on the fly (grid step = size / number of points): larger when the wave is almost empty at the window's faces (less than 10⁻⁶ of the norm in the 4 outermost cells), smaller when less than 10⁻⁶ of its probability lies outside the new window and under its new absorbing layers (with open edges); otherwise a refusal with that share. The edges' layers are 10 % of the window (15 % in a volume): they move with the window
messages.Округление: расхождение двух представлен: Round-off: the disagreement of two representations (Lorentz 4×4 and SL(2, C))
messages.Окружности (ОТО): горизонт 2M, фотонная: Circles (GR): the horizon 2M, the photon sphere 3M (the circular orbit of light), 4M the marginally bound circular orbit, the ISCO 6M the innermost stable circular orbit; the radii come from the engine (lfphys.core.gravity.kerr at zero spin).
messages.Оптическая фаза на экране: период, мс вр: Optical phase on the screen: the period, ms of the world's time
messages.Оптические вихри: пучки Лагерра–Гаусса,: Optical vortices: Laguerre–Gauss beams, orbital angular momentum, the rotational Doppler effect
messages.Оранжевый — пересечение n = 0, голубой —: Orange: the crossing n = 0, blue: n = 1, white: n = 2 (the brightest contribution in the pixel).
messages.Орбита из тех же начальных данных (тот ж: The orbit from the same initial data (the same r₀ and speed) under the other theory: Newton in a GR world, GR in a Newton world. Dashed; it does not affect the world.
messages.Орбита по потоку через плоскость на фото: Orbit from the flux through the plane per photon (Barnett's split)
messages.Орбита тела в поле Шварцшильда: непрерыв: The orbit of a body in the Schwarzschild field: continuous integration with events
messages.Орбиты и часы: ОТО и Ньютон: Orbits and clocks: general relativity and Newton
messages.Орбиты тел в поле Шварцшильда (временипо: Orbits of bodies in the Schwarzschild field (timelike geodesics)
messages.Остановить при расстоянии, G m/c²: Stop at the separation, G m/c²
messages.Остановки нет: если запуск никто не смот: There is no stop: a run nobody watches pauses by itself and after half an hour frees its worker; ⏺ continues it from the world's saved state as one record (without one, by recomputing the world along the record from its start). Going back through the history, the player starts from the nearest key frame, not from the start of the record. Runs nobody has opened for a long time are removed (except those marked ★); the period is set in the catalogue, 3 days by default.
messages.Остаток баланса E − E₀ − Q − W: Balance residual E − E₀ − Q − W
messages.Осциллятор и шар на плоскости: An oscillator and a ball on a plane
messages.Ось поворота гироскопов (после петли): Rotation axis of the gyroscopes (after the loop)
messages.Отклонение того же луча на бесконечности: Deflection of the same ray at infinity (quadrature, a reference computation)
messages.Открытые квантовые системы: управляющее: Open quantum systems: the Lindblad master equation
messages.Откуда физика этого мира: ядро движка lf: Where the physics of this world comes from: the core of the lfphys engine is established and confirmed physics; outside the core are widely used approximations, interpretations and models (each names where it departs from the core) and alternatives for “what if” experiments.

messages.Относительное движение двух невращающихс: The relative motion of two non-spinning compact bodies in the centre-of-mass frame (harmonic coordinates): conservative 1PN and 2PN corrections, 2.5PN and 3.5PN radiation reaction; the conserved 1PN/2PN energy and angular momentum; initial data from invariants (turning points as roots of the effective potential, refused with a reason when there is no orbit) and quasi-circular data with their own inspiral velocity; integration in Cartesian variables or by variation of constants (osculating elements, for weak perturbations); a step-by-step API; the Einstein delay γ of a binary pulsar.

messages.Пакет частицы летит к плоскости детектор: A particle's packet flies to a detecting plane, freely or through two slits. The run solves the Schrödinger equation on the plane (x, z) and records on the detecting plane, at every moment, the current j_z, the wave ψ and its derivative ∂ψ/∂z.

A particle's packet flies to a detecting plane, freely or through two slits. The run solves the Schrödinger equation on the plane (x, z) and records on the detecting plane the current, the wave and its derivative at every moment. From them and from the initial state the run computes the distribution of the arrival time by each rule: the quantum flux, the first arrivals of the Bohm particles, Aharonov–Bohm–Kijowski, the semiclassical rule, the absorbing boundary, the exponential rules of Wlodarz and of Marchewka–Schuss, and the soft detector (a second run with an absorbing potential). Quantum mechanics does not fix one rule: where they diverge, an experiment could tell them apart.
messages.Пакет частицы летит на пластину с двумя: A particle's packet flies at a plate with two long slits and on to a screen. The run solves the Schrödinger equation on the whole plane of the experiment (x, z), without the paraxial approximation and without Kirchhoff's boundary conditions: the wall is a potential barrier of finite height and thickness; the wave reflects by itself, passes into the slits and spreads to any angle. The screen and the window's edges absorb the wave (detectors).

A particle's packet flies at a plate with two slits and on to a screen. The run solves the Schrödinger equation on the whole plane (x, z): reflection by the plate, the wave in the slits, diffraction to any angle; the screen and the edges absorb. The pattern on the screen is the probability flowing into the screen, accumulated as the wave arrives. An ensemble of particles follows the Bohm trajectories of the same wave; each is marked by the slit it went through. The set-up can be changed on the fly: close a slit, switch on a path mark (the particle's spin or an observer, a detector at slit B), the Aharonov–Bohm flux. Nothing changes along the slits (the y axis): the 3-D wave is the exact product of the wave computed on the plane and a free Gaussian packet in y; in 3-D it is shown as a volume, the particles and the trajectories in all three coordinates, the screen as the pattern P(x, y).
messages.Пакет частицы проходит две щели в стенке: A particle's packet passes two slits in a wall of finite thickness and reaches a screen; the wave is computed on the whole plane without the paraxial approximation, the pattern accumulates as the wave arrives; an ensemble of particles follows the Bohm trajectories, marked by their slit; a path mark by spin, closing a slit and the Aharonov–Bohm flux act on the fly; in 3-D, the wave as a volume, the particles and the pattern P(x, y) (along the long slits the wave is an exact product).

Coincidence counts, the correlations E, the CHSH parameter S against the bounds 2 and 2√2, the curve E(Δ), no signalling.

To hard spheres only if no pair of atoms is closer than σ and no atom closer than σ/2 to a wall, and the scene has no molecules, piston, thermostats, field, soft walls or charges (hard spheres have none of them). Back always: the pairs' potential energy appears (the jump of the energy is stated in the event); the time step must resolve the collisions
messages.Перенос Ферми–Уокера системы гироскопов: Fermi–Walker transport of a set of gyroscopes along an acceleration programme (exact, by exponentials of the generators of the Lorentz group and, independently, of SL(2, C)); the rotation of the gyroscopes after a closed manoeuvre (holonomy) in SO(3) and SU(2); the geometry of velocity space (hyperbolic): distances, angles, the area of a polygon by Gauss–Bonnet, the isoperimetric inequality of the plane L² ≥ 4πA + A²; the motion of a charge in uniform fields and the precession of its spin (the Bargmann–Michel–Telegdi equation).
messages.Перенос гироскопа и спина в СТО: прецесс: Transport of a gyroscope and a spin in SR: Thomas precession, holonomy, BMT
messages.Перепад плотности (мера ошибки сжимаемос: Density spread (a measure of the compressibility error)
messages.Период (время между перицентрами) ↔ зако: Period (the time between periapses) ↔ Kepler's law 2π√(a³/GM)
messages.Период обращения (t) ↔ 2π√(r³/GM) (точно: Orbital period (t) ↔ 2π√(r³/GM) (exact for a circular geodesic)

messages.Песочница гравитации: звёзды, планеты, ч: A gravity sandbox: stars, planets, black holes, test bodies and light; Newtonian N bodies, a binary in GR radiating gravitational waves, geodesics near a Kerr–Newman black hole.
messages.Песочница для исследований: сцену собира: A sandbox for research: you build the scene, everything is computed live
messages.Песочница квантовой механики: волновые п: A quantum mechanics sandbox: wave packets of electrons, neutrons and atoms in a scene of barriers, wells, walls with slits, traps, magnetic fields and flux tubes; detectors, a which-path marker, an environment, measurement.
messages.Песочница молекулярной динамики: газ, кр: A molecular-dynamics sandbox: gas, crystal, molecules, walls, a piston, thermostats; the temperature, the pressure, heat and work, the Maxwell distribution as the computation goes.
messages.Песочница по разделам физики: добавляйте: A sandbox by section of physics: add objects, change their parameters on the go and watch how they move and interact. Nothing is set in advance — everything is computed by the engine's laws in real time; the conservation laws are checked live.
messages.Песочница течений: препятствия, крылья,: A flow sandbox: obstacles, wings, inlets and outlets, moving walls, dye; an incompressible fluid by the lattice Boltzmann method.

messages.Плоская (2-D) геометрия: щели бесконечно: A plane (2-D) geometry: the slits are infinitely long along y; the y coordinate of a point on the screen is for display only.
messages.Плоская волна под любым углом на одну ил: A plane wave at any angle on one or several slits in a perfectly conducting screen of finite (or zero) thickness, both polarizations (E along the slits: TE/s, H along the slits: TM/p): the mode method (waveguide modes in the slits matched to the fields of the half-spaces), for a thin screen a basis with the edge conditions; the field at any point, the angular spectrum, the far-field pattern, the transmission per slit width, the power balance (the screen's optical theorem), an estimate of the truncation error in the number of modes. Sommerfeld's exact solution for the half-plane.
messages.Плоская волна света (слева направо, вдол: A plane wave of light (from left to right, along z; polarised along x) falls on a drop. The engine solves Maxwell's equations for a sphere exactly, by the Mie series: the coefficients aₙ, bₙ of every partial wave, and from them the amplitudes S₁(θ), S₂(θ), the cross sections, the polarisation, and for small drops the field inside and around the drop (the layer “Field |E|²” and slices at any angle).
messages.Плоская петля: гироскопы поворачиваются: A planar loop: the gyroscopes turn by the loop's area in velocity space, against the direction it is run; the circle is the only case of equality in the isoperimetric bound.

The values “like MgF₂, TiO₂, gold” are illustrative, not tabulated data.

messages.Поле |E|² в объёме (внутри и вокруг капл: Field |E|² in the volume (inside and around the drop)
messages.Поле Рэлея–Зоммерфельда за отверстием в: The Rayleigh–Sommerfeld field behind an aperture in the plane z = 0: a disc on the axis (closed form), a union of rectangles at any point (a one-dimensional integral over the angle), a Gaussian field (a Hankel integral), with an error estimate; independent references for the angular-spectrum computation.
messages.Поле в плоскости z — сумма плоских волн: The field in the plane z is a sum of plane waves exp(i(k_t·r + k_z z)), k_z = √(k² − k_t²); evanescent components decay. Exact for a given field in the plane z = 0; in 3-D: transverse planes, the whole volume or exact longitudinal slices.
messages.Поле в шаре скоростей (объём и срезы): Field in the ball of velocities (volume and slices)
messages.Поле в шаре: для каждой скорости w — пов: The field in the ball: for every velocity w, the rotation of the gyroscopes after the loop rest → u → w → rest (u is set in the field's parameters), or that rotation divided by the bound at the same fuel. Slices are planes at any angle (up to three); each is computed for its own plane and checked against the area of the triangle of velocities at its points.
messages.Поле за отверстием в плоскости z = 0 рас: The field behind the aperture in the plane z = 0 propagates as a sum of plane waves (the angular spectrum); the aperture enters by its exact spectrum. The 3-D scene shows the screen, the incident wave, the light behind the aperture, the energy current and the target; any part can be switched off. Slices are planes at any angle (up to three), each with its own window; each slice is computed exactly for its plane and checked against the exact field. Slices stay where they are put; auto-move is optional.
messages.Поле за щелями — интеграл Френеля от пол: The field behind the slits is the Fresnel integral of the field in the slits (Kirchhoff's boundary conditions), in closed form through the Fresnel integrals; the x derivative for the probability current.
messages.Поле на экране — точный двумерный интегр: The field on the screen is the exact two-dimensional Rayleigh–Sommerfeld integral (its kernel is in core.optics.scalar) of the field in the slits, taken equal to the incident field (Kirchhoff's boundary conditions).
messages.Поле с полным моментом m = l + σ в систе: A field with total angular momentum m = l + σ in a frame rotating at Ω has the frequency ω − mΩ; a beam rotated at the rate Ω (a Dove prism at Ω/2) is shifted by m_out·Ω; light scattered onto the axis by a rotating surface is shifted by −lΩ, and a superposition of ±l gives beats at 2|l|Ω. Closed forms and a measurement from a time sample of the field (its spectrum).
messages.Поле только внутри трубки; снаружи — век: The field only inside the tube; outside, the vector potential
messages.Полная масса новой двойной, M☉: Total mass of a new binary, M☉
messages.Полноценная 3D-среда исследователя на дв: A full 3-D environment for a researcher on the engine: parts of the scene are switched on one by one, slices are placed and turned by hand or by parameters, the computation runs on the CPU or the GPU.
messages.Положительная — от источника (по ходу св: Positive: away from the source (along the light); negative: towards the light.
messages.Полоса Александра между дугами (углы рас: Alexander's band between the bows (scattering angles by Descartes)
messages.Поля Льенара–Вихерта (скоростная и излуч: The Liénard–Wiechert fields (the velocity and radiation parts) and potentials of a charge on a given worldline with the exact solution for the retarded time; the Larmor and Liénard power, the angular distribution (per unit of retarded and per unit of observed time); the field of a uniformly moving charge (Heaviside); synchrotron radiation: the critical frequency, F(x), G(x), the spectrum and the two polarizations, the angular and spectral distribution; the harmonics of cyclotron radiation (Schott).
messages.Поля в точках; бегущее дискретное преобр: Fields at points; a running discrete Fourier transform on lines, planes and in volumes; the Poynting flux through planes and closed boxes (in time and per frequency); scattering, absorption and extinction cross sections; the near-to-far-field transform (2-D and 3-D) through equivalent currents on a closed surface.

The run shows the orbit as the world's time t (the clock of a distant static observer) reaches it; the periapses, their advance and the body's clock are the run's measurements. GR's closed forms are only references in “Checks”. A change of r₀, the speed or the angle launches the body again at the current moment; “Push” changes the speed on the fly.

messages.Слева: «Свет» и «Длина волны» меняются с: On the left: “Light” and “Wavelength” change at once (the drop is recomputed, the sky builds up anew); the size, the spread, the substance are in “New world”. The coefficients' values are tested by “Debye series” (a second route to the same aₙ, bₙ) and “Wiscombe” (the engine against published numbers). “Angular sum at θ = 0”, “Energy” and “Mueller matrix” are identities of the series' form: they test the angular functions, the quadrature and the arithmetic, but hold also for wrong coefficients. messages.Состояние меняется на ходу (слева, «Уста: The state changes on the fly (on the left, “Set-up”): the new state is prepared at the current moment (an ideal preparation, the former one discarded); the world, its time and the slices stay, and the period counts from the moment of preparation. Another quark pair is a new world.

The state changes on the fly (on the left, “Set-up”): a new n, l, m, kind of orbital or superposition is prepared at the current moment; the world, its time and the slices stay, the cloud, the current, the slices and the checks are computed for the new state, and the period of a superposition counts from the moment of preparation. The preparation is ideal: the former state is discarded; how the atom got into the new one (a photon, a measurement) is not modelled here. Checks of the former state that the new one does not have are marked “former state”. Another atom is a new world.

The images of the disk n = 1, 2, … (n is the number of the crossing of the disk's plane along the ray traced back, the half-periods of the motion in θ) approach it e^γ times closer with each order (γ is the orbit's Lyapunov exponent). When the image is complete, the run checks: the edge of the shadow by the tracer itself against Bardeen's formula; the captured pixels against the inside of the curve; the demagnification of the rings against e^(−γ); at a = 0, the radius √27 M; the size of the shadow δ from the tracer's edge against the formula and against EHT: for Sgr A* the size itself (EHT 2022), for M87* the deviation from Kerr's (EHT 2019 calibrated the ring on Kerr).

messages.Точечная масса с радиусом Шварцшильда ка: A point mass with its Schwarzschild radius as the capture radius: a Newtonian approximation, not GR (for GR: the laws “bodies and light near a black hole”); it absorbs whatever touches it, and its radius is the Schwarzschild radius of the new mass; by default on a circular orbit around the others' centre of mass
messages.Точечные массы и пробные частицы (m = 0): Point masses and test particles (m = 0) with stable keys: bodies are added, removed and changed at the current moment; the time-symmetric fourth-order Hermite scheme P(EC)^n with a shared step by Aarseth's criterion (symmetrised over the ends of the step) for close encounters, and the fourth-order symplectic Forest–Ruth–Yoshida scheme with a constant step for long quiet systems; collisions (the moment the surfaces touch is found exactly): a merger conserving mass and momentum, or a pass-through; energy, momentum, angular momentum, centre of mass; acceleration, potential and tidal tensor at any points; an estimate of the local step error and a companion run of stricter accuracy; the state is plain data, and a restore continues the computation bit for bit.

messages.Третье измерение. Вдоль щелей (ось y) ус: The third dimension. Along the slits (the y axis) the set-up does not change, so the 3-D wave is the exact product of the wave on the plane (x, z) computed by the run and a free Gaussian packet η(y, t) of width σy (it only spreads). In 3-D the wave is shown as a volume (the layer «Wave |ψ|² in the volume»; the plane y = 0 is a separate layer), the Bohm particles and their trajectories in all three coordinates (in y a trajectory stretches together with η), the screen as the pattern P(x, y). Checks: the sum of P(x, y) over y equals the pattern P(x), the particles' hits in y follow the distribution of the flux in y.

messages.Увидеть форму орбиталей, узлы, разницу в: See the shapes of the orbitals, their nodes, the difference between real and complex states (a standing wave or a ring current) and the motion of the cloud in a superposition — all computed by the engine and verified against an independent calculation.
messages.Увидеть, как из уравнений движения ОТО п: To see how GR's equations of motion give the precession, the instability of orbits near the ISCO and the slowing of clocks, and how Newton differs; the laws can be deliberately replaced by Newton's.
messages.Увидеть, как устроены состояния 1S, 1P,: See how the states 1S, 1P, 2S, 1D of quarkonium are built and how charmonium and bottomonium differ; the model is fitted and marked as a model, the accuracy of the numerical solution is measured.
messages.Увидеть, откуда берутся радуга и её допо: See where the rainbow and its supernumerary bows come from, how the wave theory differs from the ray theory, why the bows blur for drops of different sizes, and where the glory around the antisolar point comes from.

messages.Угловое распределение (3/8π)(1 − (n·p)²): The angular distribution (3/8π)(1 − (n·p)²); the momentum transfer ħk_p(n_i − n); the residual coherence of two paths ⟨exp(i k_p (n_i − n)_x d)⟩.

messages.Угол между лучом и нормалью к поверхност: The angle between the beam and the normal to the surface. The source and both detectors stand on a rotary table: when it turns, the photons already flying along the old paths are lost (the count “lost”).
messages.Угол отклонения луча с p хордами внутри: The deflection angle of a ray with p chords inside a sphere; Descartes's rainbow angle for k internal reflections; Alexander's dark band; the classical intensity of ray tubes with Fresnel factors; Airy's theory: the intensity Ai²(−z) near the rainbow angle, the positions of the primary and the supernumerary bows.

messages.Унитарная эволюция волновой функции (мет: Unitary evolution of the wave function (the split-operator method), stationary states (the Colbert–Miller spectral method), observables and the probability current, the free Gaussian packet.
messages.Уравнение Шрёдингера (Паули) решается на: The Schrödinger (Pauli) equation is solved in a plane or in a volume; another space is a new world
messages.Уравнение Шрёдингера (и Паули) в 2-D и 3: The Schrödinger (and Pauli) equation in 2-D and 3-D
messages.Уравнение Шрёдингера в одном измерении: The Schrödinger equation in one dimension
messages.Уравнение ренормгруппы с β-функцией до ч: The renormalisation-group equation with the β function up to four loops; heavy-quark thresholds; asymptotic freedom (β₀ > 0 for n_f ≤ 16).
messages.Уравнения Максвелла в линейных изотропны: Maxwell's equations in linear isotropic media (dielectrics, magnetic materials, conductors, Drude, Lorentz and Debye dispersive media, the perfect electric conductor) are solved by Yee's scheme: 2-D (TM and TE) and 3-D; CPML absorbing layers, PEC and PMC walls, periodic sides with a Bloch phase; point and extended currents, a plane wave by the total-field/scattered-field method; spectra, Poynting fluxes, energy, absorption, scattering cross sections and the far field; edits of the scene during the run.
messages.Уравнения Максвелла во времени: метод FD: Maxwell's equations in time: the FDTD method (Yee grid) in 2-D and 3-D
messages.Уравнения Навье–Стокса несжимаемой жидко: The Navier–Stokes equations of an incompressible fluid (with a uniform body force) and the transport of a passive scalar are solved by the D2Q9 lattice Boltzmann equation (TRT collisions with the “magic” parameter 3/16, or BGK; Guo's forcing); walls by half-way bounce-back (moving ones after Ladd), curved obstacles as staircases or with Bouzidi's interpolation; a velocity inlet, a pressure outlet (anti-bounce-back), periodic sides; obstacles are added and removed at any moment with the mass accounted for; the viscosity, the density, the collision operator and the dye change at the current moment; so do the grid, the domain and the time step: the populations are carried over to the new grid (the non-equilibrium part rescaled by the relaxation times, as in the grid refinement of Dupuis and Chopard), the new part of the domain starts at rest or with the inflow; forces on obstacles by momentum exchange (drag and lift), balances of mass, momentum and dye with the fluxes through the boundaries.
messages.Уравнения Френеля (s и p), углы Брюстера: Fresnel equations (s and p), Brewster's angle and the angle of total internal reflection, transfer matrices for a stack of layers (anti-reflection coatings, mirrors, the Fabry–Pérot interferometer); the balance R + T + A = 1.
messages.Уравнения Фридмана ОТО для фотонов (из T: Friedmann's equations of GR for photons (from T_CMB), neutrinos (N_eff; massive ones by the exact Fermi–Dirac integral for density and pressure), dust-like matter, curvature and the cosmological constant: E(z), H(z), the density parameters and the deceleration parameter at z; the comoving, transverse, angular-diameter and luminosity distances, the distance modulus; lookback time, age, conformal time, particle horizon, sound horizon; a(t) by inverting t(a) and by a second route, integrating the acceleration equation; the critical density; the Planck 2018 parameters as data.
messages.Уровни и радиальные функции для централь: Levels and radial functions of a central potential in the sine basis of a box; any potential V(r), orbital angular momentum l.
messages.Уровни с приведённой массой (Шрёдингер): Levels with the reduced mass (Schrödinger) and the fine structure (the exact Dirac formula with the Barker–Glover nuclear recoil correction); exact wave functions R_nl·Y_lm (Laguerre polynomials, any n), moments ⟨r^k⟩ in closed form.
messages.Ускорение свободного падения и приливное: The free-fall acceleration and the tidal stretching at a point
messages.Усреднённые по орбите потери энергии и м: The orbit-averaged losses of energy and angular momentum to quadrupole radiation, da/dt, de/dt, the period derivative Ṗb with the factor f(e), the relation a(e), the time to merger (step by step, stopping where averaging loses its meaning); the periastron advance ω̇ (1PN) and the masses of the pulsar and its companion from ω̇ and the Einstein delay γ (γ from the core, lfphys.core.gravity.pn_binary).

messages.Установку можно менять на ходу (слева):: The set-up can be changed on the fly (on the left): close a slit, turn the spin in slit B (a path mark: the interference fades), switch on the Aharonov–Bohm flux between the slits (the fringes move), change the plate itself — the slit width a, the distance between the slits d, the thickness w and the wall height V₀ (within this world's window and screen). A change acts from that moment on: the part of the wave that has already passed the slits does not feel it; if the wave was where the wall changed, the event says what share of the probability felt the change at once.

messages.Фотоны летят по одному (оранжевые — s, с: Photons fly one by one (orange: s, blue: p). On reaching the structure a photon gets its fate by the Born rule with this run's probabilities R, T, A. While no detector has clicked, two packets (rings) are shown after the structure, their brightness by the probabilities; the click of one detector (a flash) is the outcome. When the arrival time at one detector has passed without a click, its packet fades. An absorbed photon vanishes in the structure (a red flash).

Brewster's angle, the critical angle, the spectra R(λ), T(λ), the field |E|² in the layers.
messages.Фотоны по одному: судьба каждого (отражё: Photons one by one: the fate of each (reflected, transmitted, absorbed) is drawn by the Born rule with the probabilities R, T, A computed in this run for its wavelength, angle and polarisation.

messages.Частица имеет траекторию: dx/dz = Im(Ψ†∂: A particle has a trajectory: dx/dz = Im(Ψ†∂Ψ)/(k|Ψ|²) behind slits (paraxial) or dr/dt = (ħ/m) Im(ψ†∇ψ)/(ψ†ψ) − (q/m)A for a time-dependent wave in 1-D, 2-D and 3-D (for a spinor, after Bohm–Schiller–Tiomno); initial positions are distributed by |ψ|², so the predictions for positions agree with the Born rule.
messages.Частицы Бома (параметр частицы) — интерп: Bohm particles (a particle's parameter) are an interpretation: points guided by the probability current; a point that enters a detector is registered by it and stopped (dim).
messages.Частицы вылетают по одной. Волна каждой: Particles fly out one at a time. The wave of each is a numerical solution of the Schrödinger equation on a grid (its convergence is checked against a reference); detectors at the edges absorb the wave (the detector model), and the run computes what probability each of them absorbed, and when. The particle's outcome comes in the chosen interpretation: a click and a collapse, a Bohm trajectory or Everett's branching. The statistics are the same in all three, and this is checked.

messages.Шаг сетки = длина / число узлов; по y —: Grid spacing = length / number of nodes; along y as many per metre (the height is rounded to whole cells). On the fly the flow is moved to the new grid (pressure, velocity and the non-equilibrium part of the populations, rescaled with the relaxation times, as in grid refinement), the bodies are rebuilt on the nodes. A grid beyond the memory limit is not created (the estimate is in the refusal)
messages.Шаг сетки = размер окна / число точек. М: Grid step = window size / number of points. Changes on the fly, as in the plane
messages.Шаг сетки = размер окна / число точек; с: Grid step = window size / number of points; the grid must resolve the wavelength and the shapes' edges. Changes on the fly: the wave is resampled onto the new grid exactly (by padding its spectrum with zeros). A coarser grid only when three rules hold: (1) less than 10⁻⁶ of the wave's norm lies beyond the new band of wavenumbers; (2) the new grid still resolves the wave: |k| + 6σ_k ≤ π/step, and next to a potential or a field ≤ ⅔·π/step (with the energy the potential can turn into motion); (3) the objects' edges are not narrower than ≈ 3 steps of the new grid (an edge “0” is frozen at the width the object was added with; the action “Coarsen the grid with edges to match” widens such edges at once). Otherwise a refusal with the reason and the number

messages.классическая механика (квантовые поправк: classical mechanics (quantum corrections at ħω ≳ kT, for light atoms and low T, are not included); the interactions are models (theories.models.interatomic), except the Coulomb one; step error O(dt²) for continuous forces (Verlet: energy without drift at small dt; CSVR and BAOAB: the stationary distribution with an error O(dt²)); with hard walls and the piston and interacting atoms the energy error is first order in dt (an impact inside a step); Coulomb only in a box with walls on every axis (periodic: refused, no Ewald sum); the piston is a flat specular face only on the hi side of one axis
messages.классическая электродинамика линейных из: classical electrodynamics of linear isotropic media (no nonlinearity, anisotropy or moving media); the scheme's error is the grid's numerical dispersion, second order (the grid's exact dispersion relation is checked to 6e-15); body surfaces: a staircase (1st order for curved ones; a PEC cylinder TM −1.6…−2.0 % at 40 cells per unit) or averaging over the cell, only the diagonal of Farjadpour's tensor (the scheme VP-EP in their classification): 2nd order for flat surfaces along the axes and for E along a cylinder's axis (TM), in general 1st order for E in the plane of a curved surface (a cylinder ε = 6, TE: 2.6 → 1.4 → 0.8 % at 40/80/160 cells); the flux monitor sees a plane wave weaker by a factor 1 − O((k dx)²) (cos(k dx/2) at normal incidence), so cross sections come in two normalisations: by the exact intensity and by the intensity the same monitor measures (as in Meep); a dielectric cylinder m = 1.5 at 40 cells: TM +0.03…+0.06 % / +0.10…+0.37 %, TE −0.12…+0.29 % / −0.07…+0.60 %; a sphere at 32 cells −0.01…+0.76 % / +0.16…+0.84 % of Mie (the scheme's error and the monitor's error on the scattered waves are of the same order and are not separated); reflection from a flat interface on a coarse grid up to ~11 % of R at 10 cells per wavelength in the medium (the scheme's own error, second order); CPML −88…−95 dB at 10 cells from normal incidence to ~70°, at grazing incidence (81–87°) only −75…−52 dB, which needs 16–20 cells; an axis length is the nearest one realisable on the grid (between PEC and PMC walls an odd number of half cells; checks() shows the deviation from the request); stability is checked before the run for every medium and over the node maps (a double root on the unit circle is not seen); dispersive media are the user's models (poles), the scheme's ε(ω) differs from the model by O(Δt²); energy() does not include the polarization energy
messages.классическая электродинамика точечного з: classical electrodynamics of a point charge in vacuum, a subluminal worldline; the radiation reaction on the motion is not included (the worldline is given); the synchrotron spectrum through F(x) is the ultrarelativistic limit (γ ≫ 1), Schott's harmonics are exact at any β < 1. Double precision: β is passed as a number, and 1 − β², 1 − n·β lose digits, so the relative error of the fields and of Liénard's power is of order 1e-16·γ² (measured: ~4e-8 at γ = 1e4, ~1e-4 at γ = 1e6, ~1e-2 at γ = 1e7); the retarded time is resolved to the round-off of g = cτ − R, ~4ε(cτ + |x| + |r|) + ε|v||t′| (far from the origin and near the horizon the accuracy drops; the estimate is returned)
